[[File:Admiral_Trench.png|thumb|right|170px|Admiral Trench displays his swagger stick.]]
A '''swagger stick''' was a short [[cane]] used as a symbol of authority. It was generally smaller than a full sized walking stick and not used as a mobility aid.

During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Papanoida]] of the [[Pantoran Assembly]]<ref name="Sphere">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref> and [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy]] were known to use swaggersticks.<ref name="Cat">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>{{Stub}}
